name: kakao_moment-mcp
description: 카카오모먼트 Kakao Moment (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resum

platform_mcp_kakao_moment_business_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAKAO_MOMENT_BUSINESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_kakao_moment_business_token.description: Kakao business token (비즈니스 토큰) issued by POST https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/business/token after the advertiser consents to moment_management in your biz app (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/latest/ko/business-auth/rest-api). No refresh flow; it expires after long non-use.

platform_mcp_kakao_moment_ad_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAKAO_MOMENT_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_kakao_moment_ad_account_id.description: Kakao Moment ad account number, sent as the `adAccountId` header that campaign and report calls require.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET https://kapi.kakao.com/v1/business/tokeninfo: validates the business token and lists its biz_agreements (group MOMENT with ad_account_ids).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /openapi/v4/adAccounts/pages (0-based page upstream): Kakao Moment ad accounts (ON and OFF) with raw.memberType. Limited to one call per second.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /openapi/v4/campaigns for the ad account in the ad_account_id config (adAccountId header; account_id is not sent). `status` filters config (ON, OFF, DEL); raw.systemConfig shows admin stops. The list has no budget (GET /openapi/v4/campaigns/{id} carries dailyBudgetAmount). No paging.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /openapi/v4/campaigns/report?campaignId=&start=&end=&metricsGroup=BASIC&timeUnit=DAY&level=CAMPAIGN. campaign_id is required by Kakao (up to 5, comma-separated). Kakao expects yyyyMMdd dates: pass date_from/date_to like 20260901 (end no later than yesterday). One call per 5 seconds per ad account; cost is KRW.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: PUT /openapi/v4/campaigns/dailyBudgetAmount {id, dailyBudgetAmount}: KRW, 50,000 to 1,000,000,000 in steps of 10 (`currency` is ignored); spends money. Not available for reach campaigns (Bizboard, KakaoTalk channel, Daum shopping); lowering it can cut ad group budgets and bids. One call per 5 seconds.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /openapi/v4/campaigns/onOff {id, config: OFF|ON} (only campaigns currently ON or OFF; pausing a KakaoTalk channel reach campaign suspends queued messages). Resuming restarts spending. One call per 5 seconds.
